arguments.explanation: Flags every transaction whose internal id is a multiple of 100, which is a fixed 1% slice of transactions for manual review. The slice is the same every time the rule runs.
assumptions: A random 1% is not allowed in a rule because rules must be deterministic, so I used a fixed 1% selection based on transaction id (id modulo 100 = 0).
The selection is spread by id, not chosen for any risk signal, so it is a sample rather than a targeted rule.
